messages:
Ethan (AE): MeridianPay wants a short POC to verify Redwood can replace CompetitorY with minimal infra changes. Key asks: prompt/response parity, token billing mapping, webhook semantics, and SEcurity QA. Who can pair with me for presales?
Priya (SE): I can own parity and request/response mapping. Do they need exact JSON match or functional parity for NLU intents?
MeridianPay POC - Aisha: Functional parity is our priority. We need intent match >= 95% and no breaking changes to our webhooks. Billing mapping helpful for forecasting.
Ethan (AE): Also they asked about retry/backoff and idempotency for webhooks, and ability to preserve message role metadata when moving from CompetitorY.
Priya (SE): CompetitorY uses messages[] with roles; Redwood supports chat format and completion format. Recommend canonicalizing to Redwood chat. Example request we give customers: ```json
{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"<user prompt>"}],"response_id":"<idempotency>"}
```
Jorge (SRE): For Dedicated POC we can spin up a small isolated pool. Need their allowed CIDRs and whether they want BYOK KMS or Redwood-managed keys.
Aria (Security): I'll take the QA. Note from past: CompetitorY used shared KMS keys; MeridianPay requires customer-managed KMS and HSM-backed keys. We'll require a signed DPA + subprocessors list for Dedicated.
MeridianPay POC - Aisha: We'll use CMKs in AWS KMS. DPA in progress. Can you share expected IPs and duration of the POC?
Jorge (SRE): We can provide two test endpoints (us-east-1 / eu-west-1) and a static egress IP set for firewall rules. POC pool: 2x cards, 8-24GB sessions. ETA to provision: 24 hours after CIDR + sign-off. deploy-bot: triggered job 8921 -> provisioning Dedicated test pool.
deploy-bot: Job 8921 started by Jorge. Steps: allocate -> attach KMS -> configure network. ETA 4h.
Priya (SE): For billing mapping: CompetitorY counts tokens differently (input+output with sub-tokenization). Quick mapping example from our last POC: CompetitorY 3K tokens => Redwood ~3.15K tokens (median +5%). I'll run their sample corpus to get exact numbers and a small translation script.
Ethan (AE): Deliverables we promised MeridianPay: 1) parity report (intent F1 + sample diffs), 2) token/billing mapping script & example invoice, 3) webhook behavior doc, 4) security QA answers + DPA pointer.
Aria (Security): I'll flag anything that needs Legal. Also can provide SOC2/ISO cert copies and an HSM architecture note.
MeridianPay POC - Aisha: We uploaded a 30-prompt test suite and sample webhook payloads to the shared drive. Link: https://files.redwoodinference.com/pocs/meridianpay/test-suite.zip
Priya (SE): Got it. I'll run tests against CompetitorY and Redwood and post results by tomorrow AM. Quick note: outputs will differ in subtle phrasing; we'll score on intent F1 and token delta.
Jorge (SRE): Provisioning complete. Endpoints and egress IPs emailed to Aisha. deploy-bot: Job 8921 completed.
Aria (Security): QA responses drafted and sent to Aisha. 2 items require legal (DPA signatures + subprocessors confirmation).
Priya (SE): Parity summary: intent F1 = 96.2% (meets goal), median token delta +4.8%, median p50 latency +20ms. Uploaded report: https://files.redwoodinference.com/pocs/meridianpay/parity-1789012345.pdf
MeridianPay POC - Aisha: Thanks — team will start integration smoke tests tonight and report any mapping issues.
Ethan (AE): Great. Next steps: Legal to finalize DPA, SRE to monitor POC infra, SE to run any follow-up prompts. Reopen thread for blockers. :white_check_mark:
